# Georgia Biliouli (rgbil)

> Portfolio of Georgia Biliouli, a graphic designer working in branding, packaging and cover art.

Georgia Biliouli is a graphic designer based in Greece, working across Branding, Packaging, Covers & Posters. Contact: georgia.biliouli@gmail.com

## Work

- [Kyma Coffee Roasters](https://www.behance.net/rgbil): Branding, 2025. A wordmark and packaging system for a small-batch roastery in Thessaloniki, built around the shape a wave leaves in sand.
- [Meraki Studio](https://www.behance.net/rgbil): Branding, 2025. Identity for an architecture practice that works almost entirely in reused buildings, where nothing starts from a blank page.
- [Elaia Olive Oil](https://www.behance.net/rgbil): Packaging, 2025. Bottle and label design for a single-estate olive oil from Messenia, sold mainly in northern Europe.
- [Anthos Botanicals](https://www.behance.net/rgbil): Packaging, 2024. A packaging system for a herbal tea range that had to stretch from four products to forty without being redrawn.
- [Nocturne Editions](https://www.behance.net/rgbil): Covers & Posters, 2025. Twelve covers for a small press reissuing translated European fiction, designed to be recognisable as a set from across a bookshop.
- [Athens Type Week](https://www.behance.net/rgbil): Covers & Posters, 2024. Posters for a typography festival, produced in five sizes on the same press sheet to keep the print run inside a volunteer budget.
